The overall coverage is strong for financial performance, product contributions, ad optimization, guidance, and liquidity, but the absence of strategic development framework details prevents a perfect score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The financial metrics (revenue, EBITDA, EBT, net profit) are consistently presented and support the overall narrative of growth. The relationships between the core titles (Airline Manager, Truck Manager, Farm Manager) and their contributions to total revenue/EBITDA are clearly explained. Strategic shifts (marketing reallocation, in-app advertising optimization) are logically connected to financial outcomes. The balance sheet metrics align with income statement performance. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the summary forms a clear narrative from revenue drivers through to outlook. No arithmetic contradictions are present because the candidate does not claim that segment figures are exhaustive additive components of the same total.
